method: Actual native originals and representative new images inspected directly. Compares contour character, mark-making, tonal construction and edges, separately from palette/motifs. Medium terms describe visible treatment; no claim of physical production medium. No web research, no image generation, no preferences inferred.
summary: Nine drawing directions remain visibly differentiated. NG, SB, HC, ST and BP show substantial treatment continuity; IO and FL retain strong traits with smoother rendering. RC hatching recedes. CE primary has clear engraving treatment, but F1 trades much of it for smooth tonal surfaces: calmer does not automatically mean faithful.

medium_observations: Thin controlled contour lines, angular hair locks and sharply bounded planes on clothing are retained, alongside gently shaded faces. Broad navy values and selective cyan edge light support the same digital anime drawing treatment.

limits: Bodies are more muscular and heavily shaded than the slender original; not just a palette change, but not exact line economy either. Persistent ray motif is not evidence of medium fidelity.
